requirement: Derive logical schema from train and official definitions, never from test.
handling: error if schema has no train definition
error if target appears in test or outside train_base

requirement: Require every selected predictor when transforming OOT/test.
handling: error on a missing required predictor

requirement: Align and reorder columns by name, never by position.
handling: error on duplicate names; warning for unused extras

requirement: Coerce explicitly to logical types and reject non-convertible values.
handling: error on any non-convertible non-null value

requirement: Treat physical Null/all-null columns as unobserved, not as logical types.
handling: warning; cast to train logical type

requirement: Fit imputation, scaling, selection and vocabularies only on WEEK_NUM < 74.
handling: error if fitted data include OOT/test

requirement: Map unseen OOT/test categories to __UNKNOWN__ or use a supporting encoder; never extend vocabulary.
handling: warning and reserved bucket; error if encoder cannot handle it

requirement: Permit values outside the train range unless an explicit domain constraint exists.
handling: warning for range extension; error only on domain violation/non-finite

requirement: Verify identical features, order, expected types and no infinities after every transform.
Never use test statistics to choose columns, thresholds or treatments.
handling: error/process violation if test influences fitting or design
